# TF-Locoformer (MERL)

`tflocoformer_separator.py` and `config.yaml` are unmodified copies from
[merlresearch/tf-locoformer](https://github.com/merlresearch/tf-locoformer) at commit `7a615460d347ff7334a13dbb831d16280da72cdc`,
licensed Apache-2.0 (SPDX headers kept).
`model.pth` (training start point only) is fetched by `scripts/download_pretrained.sh` from the same commit.
